name: zk-blockchain-diff-harness
description: Differential JSON-RPC test harness (MASTER blockchain-v2 M04): diffs the Go node's responses against a live `hardhat node` for every method in MASTER §9's compatibility matrix. Run via `make diff` from packages/blockchain, or directly: `HARDHAT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545 node diff.mjs`.
